version.changelog: Remove everything-sdk reference docs from distribution

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions match its stated purpose (Windows file search via Voidtools Everything); it asks for no secrets and is instruction-only, though its examples show searches that can surface sensitive files (e.g., .env).

dimensions.detail: Name/description, required binary ('ev'), Windows-only OS restriction, and instructions all target Voidtools Everything. Asking for the 'ev' CLI and requiring Everything to be running is proportionate to a file-search skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md limits actions to searching, counting, aggregating, and returning results via CLI, Python API, or MCP tools. It includes examples that read file contents (content: queries), locate .env files, export results to JSON, and show how to pipe results into further commands — all within the expected scope for a file-search utility but also able to surface sensitive data if misused. The instructions do not direct data to external endpoints or request unrelated system files or credentials.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only (no install spec executed by the registry). The README suggests installing via 'pip install everyfile', which is standard and proportionate. Voidtools Everything is a well-known external dependency; no download-from-arbitrary-URL installs are specified by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. The docs show an optional env var example ($EVERYTHING_INSTANCE) for targeting instances, which is reasonable. Be aware the tool is capable of locating files that contain secrets (e.g., .env) — this capability is inherent to file search rather than a secret request by the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No always:true flag, no persistence requested, and the skill is user-invocable only. It does not attempt to modify other skills or system-wide agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it says: a Windows-only wrapper around Voidtools Everything. Before installing or using it: 1) ensure you have Everything (from the official Voidtools site) and that the 'ev' CLI on PATH is the expected binary; 2) remember that search queries (including content: and ext:env) can locate sensitive files (passwords, .env, keys) — avoid running broad queries on systems containing secrets unless you intend to; 3) the README suggests installing a pip package named 'everyfile' — verify the PyPI package author and source if you will install it; 4) limit granting the agent broad autonomy with this tool if you do not want automated searches of user data (monitor results or require explicit user confirmation for sensitive queries). If you want further assurance, provide the everyfile package/source URL or a copy of the 'ev' binary you intend to use for a deeper check.
